content:
- ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh after push; it updated current_tasks/current_tasks_done/task_history and reported a harmless missing .ralph/current_task.txt removal
- repo is left dirty only with post-switch .ralph files plus pre-existing user edits in src/process/worker.rs and tests/ha/support/timeouts/mod.rs
- final committed head is 8fbf2c7 on master and is already pushed to origin/master
- if quitting for context reasons, resume from the new task state and avoid touching the unrelated user code edits unless explicitly asked

- used improve-code-boundaries smell 5 on the canonical conninfo boundary in src/tests
- removed duplicated TLS state from PgConnInfo (`ssl_mode` and `ssl_root_cert`) so conninfo rendering/parsing and callers now use `conninfo.tls` as the single source of truth
- swept constructor/test sites in src/cli/connect.rs, src/process/*, src/postgres_managed*.rs, src/command/mod.rs, src/ha/worker.rs, and tests/ha/support/*; next is format, make lint, make test, then commit/push/task switch if green

- cargo fmt --all, make lint, and make test are now green for the conninfo boundary refactor
- make test initially failed with a missing `.rlib` archive under target/aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu; created bug task `.ralph/tasks/bugs/bug-make-test-nextest-build-fails-missing-rlib-archive.md`, then `cargo clean --target aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu` fixed the local stale-artifact state and the rerun passed
- next is final diff review, commit all repo + .ralph changes, push to origin, then run `bash .ralph/task_switch.sh`
